title: Component
says: A holon that declares the types it takes and draws what it is given, opening space in it where what it holds is drawn in turn by the components that match.

says.says: What it draws, in a sentence.

takes.says: The types whose instances it draws; none means it draws any holon, when nothing closer matches.

draws.says: The ways it draws them: whole, as a place to read, or face, as the first understanding seen from above.

code.says: The module the interface runs, as JavaScript.

source.says: The code as it was written, before it was built.

from.says: Where the holon was born from, as a path in the files it arrived from.
